independence: Wingless-only. No Yggdrasil evidence, manifests, thresholds, representations, outcomes, or successor decisions may be consumed.
hypothesis: The current base-six/R43 representation loses decision-relevant causal trajectory information; replacing it with a fixed six-dimensional causal-trajectory representation at unchanged linear readout capacity will improve pairwise fixed-budget action choice on genuinely unseen manifests.
competing_explanation: Any apparent gain is explained by intervention identity or the old instantaneous base-six representation rather than temporally ordered within-budget state transitions.
historical_fit_partition: Exact R44 historical transfer/third/fourth/fifth manifests only. Fresh ninth/tenth/eleventh outcomes may not enter representation construction, fitting, pair selection, thresholds, or controls.

representation.name: causal_trajectory_6
representation.source: Only the within-budget transition statistics already produced before heldout outcomes: base-table change rate, top-margin movement, motif entry, motif exit, active nonbaseline motif change, and best-choice change.
features: time-weighted historical level of state_reconfiguration_rate through current budget step
current-minus-first state_reconfiguration_rate through current budget step
time-weighted historical level of confidence_movement_rate through current budget step
current-minus-first confidence_movement_rate through current budget step
time-weighted historical level of motif_turnover_rate through current budget step
current-minus-first motif_turnover_rate through current budget step
representation.time_weighting: For budget step j=1..k, level=sum(j*rate_j)/sum(j); trend=rate_k-rate_1. At k=1 trend=0.

candidate_actions: Exact existing R27 ten-allocation fixed-total candidate set; evaluate all 36 unordered pairs among the nine non-equal allocations. Pair order lexicographically frozen before fresh outcomes.
treatment: Fit a seven-parameter ridge-linear marginal-hit readout on the six causal-trajectory features using the four historical manifests. For each fresh manifest, freeze all nine action scores and pair choices before revealing actual hits.

controls.base6_same_capacity: Fit the same seven-parameter ridge-linear readout on the existing six instantaneous R27/base-six features using the identical historical partition.
controls.action_only: Rank by historical mean realized value for each allocation using the identical historical partition.

classification_rules.supported: valid; >=72 non-tie pairs; trajectory accuracy exceeds base6 by >=0.08; trajectory beats base6 on at least two of three fresh manifests; and trajectory mean regret <=0.90*base6 mean regret.
classification_rules.mixed: valid; support false; trajectory accuracy exceeds base6 by >=0.02; trajectory beats base6 on at least two of three fresh manifests; and trajectory mean regret is lower than base6.
classification_rules.negative: valid and neither supported nor mixed.
classification_rules.invalid: any exact source/blob/prefix, historical partition, candidate action/pair order, fixed budget, six-dimensional representation, seven-parameter readout, heldout ordering, deterministic replay, provenance, or accounting rule fails.

negative_interpretation: Stop representation-local ranking work and move upstream to learning-state formation; do not tune or sweep additional trajectory transforms over this result.
infra_failure_policy: Exact infrastructure repair and deterministic rerun only. Scientific negative/mixed outcomes are immutable evidence.
